thread:
anya: quick UX pass — tooltip for 'Model CPU usage' feels a bit technical. can we make it more action-oriented?
tim: agree. current: 'Model CPU usage is averaged over 1 min cycles.' suggestion: 'Usage shown is a 1‑minute average — helps spot short spikes.'
lara: nice. shorten to 'Shown as a 1‑minute average to surface short spikes.'
sam: q: where does this tooltip appear? billing modal and per-route settings, right? need consistent phrasing across both.
anya: yep both. also a11y: tooltip needs an aria-label that reads the full sentence.
design-bot: lint reminder: component tooltip max chars 120.
tim: ok keep under 110 to be safe. new proposed copy: "Shown as a 1‑minute average to highlight short spikes in usage." (98 chars)
lara: minor nit: 'highlight' → 'surface' is more neutral. "Shown as a 1‑minute average to surface short spikes in usage." (101 chars)
sam: approve from product. @anya can you update the strings and add alt text for screen readers (same sentence)?
anya: will update in Figma and open PR. also adding a11y note in the component doc: 'tooltip should be announced on focus'.
design-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/3214 by anya
tim: thanks! will quick-review.
lara: tiny follow-up — quotas page empty state currently says 'No usage yet'. can we make it a little more helpful? suggestion: "No activity yet. We'll show usage after your first request."
sam: +1. keep it concise. we already surface links to docs elsewhere.
anya: i'll push two tiny PRs: one for tooltip copy + aria-label, one for quotas empty state copy. est time: 30m
design-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/3215 by anya
tim: quick note: error toast for 'failed to save policy' currently reads 'Save failed'. suggestion: 'Unable to save policy. Try again.' longer variant: 'Unable to save policy. Try again — contact support if it persists.'
lara: keep the toast short. we already link to support in details drawer. 'Unable to save policy. Try again.'
sam: agree. less scary.
anya: will update toast copy in the component lib too.
tim: LGTM.
sam: closing loop — i'll add these to the weekly release notes under 'small UX tweaks' :thumbsup:
